nodes.description: Owner address of InvestorsStorage, set to msg.sender in constructor and used by the onlyOwner access-control modifier.
Private itmap storage holding investor records, keys array and best investor/promouter records.
Public admin address that receives the 5% commission via a raw transfer.
Reference to the InvestorsStorage contract instance, replaced on every nextWave().
Mapping address=>address storing the referral of each investor.
Accumulated ETH invested, incremented with raw arithmetic in doInvest.
Counter of investments, reset in nextWave.
Timestamp of the current wave start, written from block.timestamp.
Private advertise-token balance mapping initialized with the whole supply to the contract.
Public mapping recording which caller advertised to which address; used to grant the 1% advertising bonus.
Payable investment entry point: handles referral bonuses, dividends, admin commission and investor storage writes.
Public wrapper that pays the caller's pending dividends, guarded by the balanceChanged modifier.
Private dividend calculation and payout routine based on block.timestamp and stored payment time.
Private helper that pushes dividends with the low-level send() call.
Private helper that pushes dividends plus referral bonus with the low-level send() call.
Private routine that deploys a new InvestorsStorage, resets counters and stamps waveStartup with now.
Payable fallback: zero-value calls withdraw dividends, non-zero value calls doInvest with an address decoded from msg.data.
onlyOwner function inserting a new investor record into the iterable map.
onlyOwner function that adds value to an existing investor with unchecked storage arithmetic.
onlyOwner function accumulating referral bonus for an investor.
onlyOwner function adding referral bonus and incrementing the referrer counter.
onlyOwner function writing the investor payment timestamp.
onlyOwner function overwriting the stored referral bonus.
Advertising-only transfer that records the caller as advertiser of the target address.
Loops over an address array registeriing the caller as advertiser for each entry.
Public, unguarded function accumulating per-day invested/investor statistics.
Raw ETH transfer of the 5% admin commission executed before investor storage is updated.
Low-level send() pushing dividends to an investor address, an external call inside payout flow.
Unchecked addition to totalInvested using raw Solidity arithmetic.
Unchecked accumulation of an investor's stored value inside addValue.
Privileged admin address assigned directly from msg.sender in the constructor.
Storage owner assigned directly from msg.sender in the InvestorsStorage constructor.
Elapsed-time computation whose input derives from block.timestamp.
Caller-controlled address used for investor identity, referral lookups and payouts.
Miner-influenceable time source (now) driving dividend periods, payment times and wave startup.
Referrer address supplied by the investor when calling doInvest.
Flag deciding whether dividend retrieval reverts or silently returns.
Recipient address of the dividend payout.
Dividend amount passed to send().
Investor address whose stored value is increased.
Amount added to the investor's stored value.
Investor address being inserted in the iterable map.
Initial value recorded for the new investor.
Bonus amount accumulated for the referral.
Timestamp written as the investor's latest payment time.
Memory copy of the caller's investor record loaded from InvestorsStorage.
Number of dividend periods elapsed since the last payment.
Invested amount, possibly inflated by the 3.55% referral bonus.
Address decoded from msg.data (first 20 bytes) and forwarded to doInvest.
Computed referral bonus written into InvestorsStorage.
Date key (yyyymmdd) built from the timestamp and used for stats.

edges.reason: Any external caller can trigger the payable fallback, the entry point of the scheme.
Fallback with msg.value > 0 routes execution into doInvest.
Fallback with msg.value == 0 routes execution into getMyDividends.
The investor identity used in doInvest is msg.sender, never validated for access.
Dividend entitlement depends on block.timestamp, a miner-influenceable value (timestamp dependency).
now.sub(paymentTime) derives directly from block.timestamp, coupling payouts to miner time.
Elapsed-period value feeds the dividend amount computation inside _getMyDividents.
nextWave stamps waveStartup with now.
adminAddr is initialized from msg.sender in the constructor.
Constructor assignment writes the untrusted deployer into the adminAddr state variable.
owner of InvestorsStorage is initialized from msg.sender in the constructor.
Constructor assignment writes the untrusted deployer into the owner state variable.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
insert is gated by onlyOwner against the stored owner.
addValue is gated by onlyOwner against the stored owner.
addRefBonus is gated by onlyOwner against the stored owner.
addRefBonusWithRefs is gated by onlyOwner against the stored owner.
setPaymentTime is gated by onlyOwner against the stored owner.
setRefBonus is gated by onlyOwner against the stored owner.
The admin commission is sent to the privileged adminAddr.
doInvest pays the 5% admin commission before updating investor storage.
Raw ETH transfer to adminAddr happens before m_investors writes, allowing state-consistent re-entry into doInvest.
doInvest invokes _getMyDividents(true) to flush pending dividends.
Payout path with no referral bonus goes through sendDividends.
Payout path with referral bonus goes through sendDividendsWithRefBonus.
sendDividends performs the external low-level send() call.
sendDividendsWithRefBonus performs the external low-level send() call.
Within doInvest the dividend send() executes before m_investors value/paymentTime writes.
Investor receives ETH via send() before storage finalization and can re-enter doInvest.
A payout recipient can re-enter the public getMyDividends wrapper.
_getMyDividents updates the payment time before computing/sending dividends.
If the balance is insufficient, _getMyDividents starts a new wave.
nextWave replaces the m_investors storage contract instance.
nextWave writes the waveStartup state variable from the current timestamp.
Existing investors are topped up through addValue.
New investors are registered through insert.
doInvest accumulates daily statistics through updateStats.
doInvest credits referral bonus to the second-level or best referrer.
doInvest credits the first-level referrer and increments his referral count.
doInvest resets the investor's payment time after the deposit.
The invested ETH amount flows into the unchecked totalInvested increment.
totalInvested is updated with raw, unchecked addition.
addValue performs unchecked storage accumulation of the investor value.
Unchecked arithmetic mutates the investor record inside the itmap storage.
ERC20 advertising transfer records the advertiser mapping entry.
massAdvertiseTransfer writes advertiser entries in a loop.
The advertiser recorded by transfer() is msg.sender.
The advertiser recorded by massAdvertiseTransfer() is msg.sender.
adtransfers[msg.sender] is consulted inside doInvest to grant the 1% advertising bonus.
The caller-supplied referrer argument enters doInvest.
The supplied referrer receives the first-level bonus via addRefBonusWithRefs.
The withoutThrow flag changes the control path of _getMyDividents.
The recipient parameter of sendDividends is used as the send() target.
The recipient parameter reaches the low-level send call.
The value parameter of sendDividends is the amount pushed to the recipient.
The addr parameter selects the investor record mutated by addValue.
The value parameter is added to the investor record by addValue.
The value parameter feeds the unchecked storage addition.
The addr parameter keys the new investor record inserted by insert.
The value parameter is stored as the initial investor value by insert.
The refBonus parameter is accumulated into the investor bonus by addRefBonus.
The paymentTime parameter is written into the investor record.
The memory investor copy drives the dividend computation in _getMyDividents.
daysAfter scales the dividend payout inside _getMyDividents.
daysAfter is derived from now (block.timestamp), creating timestamp dependency.
The local value carries the invested amount through doInvest.
The local value (which may include a 3.55% bonus) is written into investor storage.
The address decoded from msg.data is forwarded as the referrer to doInvest.
The computed reward is credited through addRefBonus.
The computed reward is credited through addRefBonusWithRefs.
The derived date key indexes the statistics update.

normalization_plan.reason: The referrer argument is a transient input consumed exclusively by the doInvest flow.
The revert/return flag only selects a branch inside _getMyDividents.
The recipient argument exists only as the payout target of sendDividends.
The amount argument exists only for the send() performed by sendDividends.
The key argument is used solely to locate the record mutated by addValue.
The amount argument flows directly into the unchecked addition inside addValue.
The address argument keys the record created by insert.
The value argument initializes the record created by insert.
The bonus argument is merged into the accumulated bonus by addRefBonus.
The timestamp argument is written only by setPaymentTime.
The memory copy of the investor record is a temporary working value of the dividend routine.
The elapsed-period value is a temporary divisor computed inside the dividend routine.
The invested amount local is a transient accumulator inside doInvest.
The msg.data-derived address is immediately forwarded to doInvest.
The computed reward is transiently held before being credited via addRefBonus.
The derived date key is used only as the index of the statistics update.
